# Pharmec Technologies Co., Ltd.

> > Pharmec Technologies is a Shanghai-based manufacturer specializing in pharmaceutical filling lines, water treatment systems, and liquid preparation equipment for global markets.

Pharmec Technologies Co., Ltd. is a Chinese pharmaceutical equipment manufacturer offering OEM/ODM services for filling lines and water treatment systems. The company serves markets across North America, Europe, Africa, and the Middle East with GMP-compliant manufacturing solutions.

## Key Topics

- Liquid/Powder Vial Filling Line
- Ampoule Filling Line
- Oral Liquid/Syrup Filling Line
- Pharmaceutical Water Treatment System
- Purified Water Generation System
- Pure Steam Generator
- Eye Drop Filling Machine
- BFS Machine (Blow-Fill-Seal)
- CIP (Clean-in-Place)
- Water Distiller
- Granulation Equipment
- OEM/ODM Services
- GMP Compliance
- Aseptic Filling
- Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
